rules.component_identity: Every reusable component has stable id, version, contract, dependencies, tests, evidence and certification state.
rules.promotion: DESIGN → EXPERIMENTAL → CANDIDATE → VALIDATED → CERTIFIED → PRODUCTION
rules.certified_requirement: Certification requires reproducible tests, evidence, compatibility profile and proven reuse.
rules.unknown_rule: If no suitable certified component exists, return NEW_BLOCK_REQUIRED or HUMAN_ENGINEERING_REQUIRED.

components.name: FATHER Voice / TTS Profile Component
components.purpose: Reusable text-to-speech component and voice-profile template for FATHER agents and products requiring spoken output.

source_context.implementation_location: local workspace; central code path not yet baselined in OTUS- repository

evidence.description: Local voice lab page loaded successfully and TTS request was received by the running service; user confirmed the voice flow works.

security_profile: voice/provider credentials scoped outside source control
trace without raw sensitive content by default
components.promotion_condition: Pass regression + compatibility + second-product reuse evidence.
